name: ecommerce-gift-cards-and-store-credit-livewire
display_name: Gift Cards and Store Credit Livewire
description: The one place in this fleet where hostile input meets a bearer credential: a box a shopper types a gift card code into. The code is an action argument rather than a property, so it is never component state, never dehydrated back to the browser, never flashed and never logged. Every refusal — wrong code, disabled, expired, wrong currency, short, conflicting, rate limited — is the same sentence. The amount is priced by the host on the server and no browser can name it.
features: A gift card code that is an action argument and never a property
No component property a code could be hydrated into
Every refusal answers with one identical sentence
One shape as well as one message: the state after every refusal is the same
A code that survives no further than the call that spends it
Proved by a test that walks the component's whole serialised state
Rate limited per actor by the domain and per IP by this package
A throttled attempt answers exactly as a wrong code does
Only the last four characters and the balance are ever shown back
Every public property locked, enforced by reflection over every registered component
No exceptions list on that rule, because there is nothing to except
The amount priced by the host on the server, on the request that spends
No money property on any component, locked or otherwise
An idempotency key derived from the step, so a reload cannot debit twice
A permanent conflict refuses and mints nothing
A signed-in customer's own balances, folded from the ledger
No balance lookup by code, because that is an oracle over the code space
Live regions announcing every outcome, and a labelled field
Registered by resolveMissingComponent, never by a namespace map
